ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The FIR direct-form structure in the figure starts from the input x[n], and the main signal line sequentially passes through two unit delay modules labeled “Unit Delay”. Before entering the delay chain, the input end branches off, passes through a multiplier with gain 5, and is then sent to the positive terminal of the summing device on the right; the signal after passing through two unit delays also branches off, passes through another multiplier with gain 5, and is then sent to the negative terminal of the same summing device, with output y[n]. Reasoning: From the plus and minus signs in the figure, the output is the current input branch minus the two-sample delayed branch, namely y[n] = 5x[n] - 5x[n-2]. Therefore the transfer function is H(z)=Y(z)/X(z)=5(1-z^-2). On the unit circle, H(e^{jω})=5(1-e^{-j2ω}), and its magnitude is zero at ω=0 and ω=π, and is maximum near the middle of the frequency band. Therefore this structure suppresses low frequencies and high frequencies and passes the middle frequency band, and can be used as an approximate band-pass filter.

raw_record.question_text: The direct form structure of an FIR (finite impulse response) filter is shown in the image. What type of filter can this structure be used to approximate?

method.method_draft: First describe the image structure: identify the two cascaded unit delays and the two gain-5 branches entering the final summer with opposite signs. Translate the diagram into the difference equation y[n] = 5x[n] - 5x[n-2]. Convert to the transfer function H(z)=Y(z)/X(z)=5(1-z^-2). Evaluate on the unit circle: H(e^{jω})=5(1-e^{-j2ω}), whose magnitude is zero at ω=0 and ω=π and largest around the middle of the band. Since low and high frequencies are rejected while a middle band is passed, conclude that the structure can approximate a band-pass filter.

推理：由图中正负号可得输出为当前输入支路减去两拍延迟支路，即 y[n] = 5x[n] - 5x[n-2]。因此传递函数为 H(z)=Y(z)/X(z)=5(1-z^-2)。在单位圆上，H(e^{jω})=5(1-e^{-j2ω})，其幅度在 ω=0 和 ω=π 处为零，在频带中间附近最大。因此该结构抑制低频和高频、通过中间频段，可用于近似带通滤波器。
